rules.statement: An interlocutory decree for the sale of property under the Partition Act can include encumbrances, such as a life interest, and does not necessarily pass an unencumbered title.
rules.supporting_quote: "In such a case it cannot be contended that a sale under the Partition Ordinance must be free from all encumbrances."

meta.parties: Ceylon Theatres Ltd. v. Cinemas Ltd
